title: Steam generator drain fault
shortDescription: Steam generator failed to drain within the allotted time.
fullDescription: The Rational SCC/iCombi detected that the steam generator did not empty properly. Usually caused by clogged drain or faulty drain valve. The unit will pause cooking and require service.

causes.cause: Clogged drain line or scale buildup

fixSteps.title: Run CleanJet+
fixSteps.instruction: Run the descale cycle with Rational tablets to clear scale.

fixSteps.title: Inspect drain
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect drain hose and clear blockages.

fixSteps.title: Test drain valve
fixSteps.instruction: Have technician test solenoid coil resistance and replace if open.

whenToCallPro: Call a Rational-certified technician for valve replacement or sensor diagnostics.

faq.q: Can I keep using the oven?
faq.a: No, steam functions are locked until the fault is cleared.

title: Steam generator fill fault
shortDescription: Water did not reach required level in steam generator.
fullDescription: The Rational unit could not fill the steam generator within the timeout. Typically caused by closed water supply, clogged inlet filter, or failed fill valve.

causes.cause: Water supply shut off or low pressure

fixSteps.title: Check water supply
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm water shutoff is open and pressure is at least 30 psi.

fixSteps.title: Clean inlet strainer
fixSteps.instruction: Close water, remove inlet hose, clean mesh filter.

fixSteps.title: Replace fill valve
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces solenoid if coil/valve fails.

whenToCallPro: If the supply is healthy and strainer is clean, call a technician.

title: Steam generator overheat
shortDescription: Steam generator temperature exceeded safe limits.
fullDescription: Excessive scale buildup or low water level caused the steam generator to overheat. Triggered by hi-limit thermostat. Requires descaling and inspection.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Allow unit to cool for 30 minutes before restart.

fixSteps.title: Service inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Technician resets hi-limit and tests element/sensor.

whenToCallPro: Always call a tech if hi-limit trips repeatedly.

faq.a: Yes, Rational requires softened water under 60 ppm hardness.

title: Cabinet temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: Cabinet PT1000 sensor open or shorted.
fullDescription: The cabinet temperature probe is reporting out-of-range values. Cooking is disabled to prevent damage. Requires sensor replacement.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn breaker off 60 seconds and back on.

whenToCallPro: Sensor replacement requires opening the back panel; call a tech.

faq.a: Stop cooking and transfer food to another oven until repaired.

title: Core probe fault
shortDescription: Core temperature probe is shorted or open.
fullDescription: The internal core temperature probe is sending invalid signals. Core-probe cooking modes will be disabled until probe is replaced.

fixSteps.title: Inspect probe
fixSteps.instruction: Check the cable for kinks, cuts, or melted insulation.

fixSteps.title: Replace probe
fixSteps.instruction: Plug a new core probe into the cabinet socket.

whenToCallPro: Only if internal probe socket needs rewiring.

title: Fan motor fault
fullDescription: The fan motor is not turning at expected RPM or has overheated. The frequency converter has signaled a fault. Cooking is paused.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off at breaker for 5 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Clear airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Make sure rear vents and roof intakes are unblocked.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces motor or frequency converter.

whenToCallPro: Motor and inverter work require a Rational technician.

title: Frequency inverter overheat
fullDescription: The motor inverter has exceeded thermal limits. Usually caused by blocked component-cooling fan or clogged filter behind the side panel.

fixSteps.title: Clear vents
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe and clear vents on the bottom-front and back of unit.

fixSteps.title: Check ambient
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure kitchen ambient is below 104F (40C) at the oven.

fixSteps.title: Service fan
fixSteps.instruction: Technician inspects and replaces internal cooling fan.

whenToCallPro: If clearing vents does not resolve, call service.

faq.a: Ambient over 104F at intake will trip Error 31.

title: Door switch fault
fullDescription: The door is reported open while cooking is active or vice versa. Caused by misaligned door, dirty switch, or wiring fault.

fixSteps.title: Reseat door
fixSteps.instruction: Open and firmly close, ensure handle clicks.

fixSteps.title: Clean gasket and switch
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe down door gasket and reed switch area.

fixSteps.title: Service switch
fixSteps.instruction: Technician replaces reed switch or checks harness.

whenToCallPro: Persistent fault after cleaning needs a tech.

faq.a: Worn gasket can also cause this fault; replace if torn.

title: CleanJet pump fault
shortDescription: Cleaning system pump did not run correctly.
fullDescription: The CleanJet circulation pump is not delivering expected flow. Cleaning cycle aborted. Often due to clogged pump impeller or sump filter.

fixSteps.title: Clean sump
fixSteps.instruction: Remove sump cover, clear food debris.

faq.a: Use only Rational Active Green tabs to avoid pump damage.

title: Steam generator descale required
shortDescription: Scheduled descale due based on water usage.
fullDescription: Service 110 is a maintenance reminder to descale the steam generator. The unit will continue to function but warns of declining efficiency.

causes.cause: Accumulated scale based on usage counter

fixSteps.title: Run descale
fixSteps.instruction: Use CleanJet+Care descale function with descale tabs.

fixSteps.title: Confirm reset
fixSteps.instruction: Service code clears automatically after successful run.

whenToCallPro: Only if descale fails to clear the message.

faq.a: Frequency depends on water hardness; softeners reduce alerts.
